newsitem.title: GERMANY: DIARY - NEW EQUITIES ISSUES IN GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - NEW EQUITIES ISSUES IN GERMANY.

text.p: Diary of new issues in Germany:
Company name Size/type of issue Expected date
IAT Multimedia Inc 3.1 mln ordinary shares Early April 1997 IPO
Note: German-Swiss high-tech company IAT plans capital increase of approx 23
mln dollars through listing on NASDAQ and on Berlin and Frankfurt unregulated
markets. Par value of shares 0.01 dollars. Initial price of issue between 5.50
and 6.50 dollars. Company has granted 465,000 additional shares to cover
possible over-allotment. Subscription through Dominick & Dominick, Hamburg.
BHW Holding AG about 270 mln DM April 28, 1997 IPO
Note: Issue will constitute about 30 pct of future equity capital, made up of
135 mln DM from capital increase and 135 mln from existing shareholders, BGAG
(German Trade Union Holding Co) and BTA (German Civil Servants Association).
Current 49 pct stake of both BGAG and BTA will be reduced to 35 pct. 1996 group
net profits up 25 pct to 189.9 mln DM vs 1995's 151.2 mln DM. Shares to be
listed in Frankfurt and Hanover. Bookbuilding range 25 to 30 DM described as
realistic by Managing Director Reinhard Wagner. Earnings per share rose in 1996
to 1.30 DM vs 1.00 DM in 1995. Joint Global Coordinators Deutsche Morgan
Grenfell, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Credit Suisse First Boston. Greenshoe of 2
to 3 percent of equity capital.
Joh A. Benckiser GmbH - Spring 1997 IPO
Note: Company plans to list its cosmetic activities on the New York bourse
under the name of Coty Inc, and its cleaning activities (Benckiser NV) in
Amsterdam by the end of 1997.
H.I.S. Sportswear AG ordinary shares 1st half 1997 IPO
Note: Company plans listing on Frankfurt and Munich regulated markets. Equity
capital is 22.3 mln DM. Sales 1995/96 165 mln DM (vs 150 mln) Consortium leader
is Commerzbank. Present sole shareholder, CHIC by H.I.S. Inc of New
York, intends to reduce stake but remain majority shareholder.
Integrata Training AG - 1st half 1997 IPO
Note: Information technology training course provider plans listing on
Stuttgart unregulated market. Company's equity capital is 3 mln DM. Broker for
the issue is Baader Wertpapier GmbH in Munich. Group sales 1996 approx 135 mln
DM.
WRE AG 3.5 mln DM cap.increase July, 1997
Note: Private placement by WRE, constructor and operator of small power
stations. Will be the third capital increase since company's founding in
February 1996 and will bring total capital to 7.0 mln DM. Price of issue 10 DM.
Stock exchange listing planned for 1999 on Frankfurt unregulated market. Stock
trading per Internet planned within next few months.
Pro Sieben Media AG 17.5 mln non-voting July, 1997 IPO
prefs
Note: German TV company plans stock market listing. Issue will be made up of 75
mln DM from existing shareholder Thomas Kirch and 12.5 mln DM from a capital
increase totalling 25 mln DM. Price of issue 5 DM, dividend advantage over
ordinary shares 3 pct. Following stock market listing, equity capital will
total 175 mln DM. Thomas Kirch will hold 60 pct and the German supermarket
giant Rewe Handelsgruppe AG will hold 40 pct of the ordinary shares. Consortium
leaders Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechselbank AG (Hypo-Bank) and BHF-Bank
AG.
Bechstein AG 2600 registered shares Early Autumn, 1997 IPO
Note: German piano manufacturer plans listing on Berlin unregulated market.
Equity capital is 2 mln DM. Par value of issue is 500 DM per share. Sales price
per share is 2000 DM. Company sales rose in 1996 to 31 mln DM vs 27.2 mln DM in
Teles AG - Autumn, 1997 IPO
Note: Multimedia company Teles AG plans listing on NASDAQ and a european
bourse, probably in Germany or the EASDAQ in Brussels. Sales in 1996 increased
to 70 mln DM vs 23 mln DM in 1995. Pretax profits 1996 up to approx. 14 (vs
3.3) mln DM. Company's equity capital is 1.275 mln DM.
Utimaco Safeware AG at least 0.5 mln DM early 4th qrtr 1997 IPO
Note: Computer security company plans listing on Frankfurt new growth stock
market "New Market". Equity capital is currently 2 mln DM and a capital
increase of at least 25 pct is planned for stock market listing. Group sales in
1995/96 increased to 33 mln DM vs 25.1 mln DM in 1994/95. Company's current
major shareholders are Managing Director Horst Goertz (45 pct), the venture
capital company Abax (14 pct) and Linz Textil Holding (14 pct).
Lufthansa about 3 bln DM 4th quarter 1997
Note: Government plans to sell remaining 36 pct stake. Share type: Registered
share, not freely transferable. Foreign ownership of Germany's largest airline
will be limited to 50 pct.
K&M Moebel AG ordinary shares 1997 IPO
Note: Company plans listing on Frankfurt and Duesseldorf stock exchanges.
Equity capital 35 mln DM. Price of issue 5 DM. Joint consortium leaders UBS
Schweizerische Bankgesellschaft (Deutschland) AG and WestLB .
Current owners are ECP, First Britannia (75 pct), founding family and
management members (25 pct) and partly intend to remain major shareholders.
Komatsu Hanomag AG 375,050 shares unknown
Note: Construction machinery producer intends to double equity capital to
approx 37.5 mln DM. Nominal value of 18,752,500 DM of 50-DM shares. Shares
entitled to dividend for 1997.
IDS Prof. Scheer GmbH - 1998 IPO
Note: IDS, software manufacturer and consultancy, plans listing on German and
US stock exchanges. NASDAQ listing is being considered.
Newly listed companies 1997
Company name Size/type of issue Date IPO
MobilCom AG 640,000 shares March 10, 1997 IPO
Note: 5-DM ordinary bearer shares. Initial offering price 62.50 DM. First
trading price 95.00 DM. More than 100 times oversubscribed. Greenshoe option
fully exercised. Consortium leader DG Bank.
Enquiries: Catherine Carlin, Reuters Frankfurt bureau.
